# Shibumi 0.2.3

2026-11-11

Performance and maintenance release for Omarchy 4.5: validated on Omarchy 4.5.0 (package 4.5.0-3, source v4.5.0 at ac2690cd7); forward reference f428bb4f. Nothing changes visibly. 0.2.0, 0.2.1 and 0.2.2 installations update in place.

## What's Changed

### Performance

- **perf:** refresh AI usage every 15 minutes only for the providers that have a tab; new providers are found at startup, every six hours, when the AI panel opens and after a failed refresh (09cb5970)
- **perf:** start AI usage collection ten seconds after the shell is up and no longer force it; existing records show at once (3e3a8dc4)
- **perf:** skip the Bar's layout request when the settled state and the native layout already match (a5f2ec1d)

### Bug Fixes

- **fix:** keep the picker image style across `deactivate --keep-layout` and `activate` (cbbf9f4d)
- **fix:** keep the AI provider tabs in a fixed order when another provider is selected (f4454398)
- **fix:** read OpenCode 2.x usage and count migrated messages once; the legacy store is still read (88d58311)

### Maintenance

- **refactor:** remove unused declarations across 14 plugins and two orphaned test fixtures (781f3a05…3fef35f4)
- **test:** derive host layout and monitor checks from capabilities instead of id lists (72d65e5b)
- **test:** pin forward compatibility to Omarchy quattro f428bb4f (0c05be1d)
- **docs:** describe the established OPR release workflow (e81617cf)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.2.2...v0.2.3
